Steady Income model, hypothetical results for the periods ending December 31, 2025: 1 year 8.9% gross, 7.8% net; 5 years 7.1% gross, 6.0% net; 10 years 7.6% gross, 6.5% net (5- and 10-year figures are average annual returns). The model holds a fixed 60/40 mix of two broad index funds, rebalanced each January, with net figures deducting the 1.00% annual advisory fee and trading costs; no client account holds the model. Model trade records from before 2022 were not retained. Hypothetical results have inherent limitations, do not reflect actual trading, and cannot account for the effect of market conditions on decision-making; the model could have lost money in any period. This one-pager is provided only to prospective clients who request it.
